## Assets

Create subfolders called `images`, `sounds` and `music`. Pygame Zero looks in them to find your images, sounds and music.

{{< include /course/shared/concepts/_asset-rules.qmd >}}

## Sounds

Plays shorter `.ogg` or `.wav` audio files. These are for sound effects in your game! Sound functions are called in this format: `sounds.<filename>.<function>()` ([docs]({{< var pgzero.docs >}}/builtins.html#sounds)).

```{.python include="code/sounds.py" snippet="sounds" dedent=4}
```

## Music

Plays longer `.ogg` or `.mp3` audio files. These are for background music in your game! ([docs]({{< var pgzero.docs >}}/builtins.html#music))

## Tone

Generates sounds using a built-in synthesizer. `tone.play(pitch, duration)` plays a tone at a certain pitch for a specified length in seconds. `volume` goes from 0 (silent) to 1 (max), default 0.8. `waveform` can be `"sin"` (default), `"square"`, `"saw"` or `"triangle"`.

```python
tone.play("E4", 0.5)  # plays an E in octave 4 for 0.5 seconds
tone.play("A#5", 0.25)  # plays an A sharp in octave 5 for 0.25 seconds
tone.play("Bb3", 0.75)  # plays a B flat in octave 3 for 0.75 seconds
tone.play("C4", 1, volume=0.5)  # plays C4 for 1 second at half volume
tone.play("C4", 1, waveform="square")  # plays C4 for 1 second, square wave
```
